architecture.LG: Optical router224 + 4x224 experts, Top2, gap30, global478; E -> OEO -> G -> OEO -> fixed CCD; 479364 phase parameters; no learned electronic frontend/readout
architecture.D2NN: Three continuous478 phase layers, no intermediate OEO, fixed same CCD regions; 685452 phase parameters; no learned electronic frontend/readout
architecture.input: RGB each112; [R,G;B,0]224, unit power. LG copies224 to experts; D2NN bilinear expands to478. Fourth quadrant remains zero.
